admission.justification: The developer's amendment kept the controls and their behavior while removing the text block; Result losing its re-read/steering would silently drop the launcher's steering of the frame, a costly regression the base behavior guards. The rule is a member of the launcher-strip family.

applicability: The Result control when the selected execution has an answer to re-read.
conditions: The handler re-reads the selected execution and refreshes its capabilities before opening the reader.
The chat frame remains the same mounted element while the reader is open and after it is closed.
exclusions: The report's display is rule 4's; this rule preserves what the control did before the change.
The removed block is not restored by the re-read.

evidence: notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L75-reviewer-e90aa7a7-6651-4eb6-ab32-c6bfb33a38ac-evidence/ui-focused.log: PaseoChatFrame Result refresh and retained iframe tests

statement: Result preserves execution rereading, capability refresh and mounted frame steering before opening the shared reader.
